ModMetaData.name: RimLLM Framework
ModMetaData.author: 綠菇
ModMetaData.description: RimLLM Framework — A unified LLM interface and core infrastructure framework for RimWorld. This mod provides a stable, high-performance, and flexible foundation for managing API keys, model fallback, prompt caching, and provider configurations, freeing mod developers from reinventing the wheel. It seamlessly integrates major LLM providers (Gemini, OpenAI, local-compatible endpoints, and more), maximizing the stability, security, and maintainability of in-game AI features. Key Features: 1. Multi-Provider Support: Native integration for Google Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Grok (xAI), Z.ai, OpenRouter, Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen, NVIDIA, Player2, and any OpenAI-compatible local/remote endpoint (LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM, etc.). 2. Smart Model Fallback: Precision model-level fallback chain. Configure a primary model with backup candidates; the framework automatically switches on timeout, rate limits (429), or network errors. Supports four routing strategies (Chain Priority, Lowest Latency, Round-Robin, Lowest Cost), exponential backoff with jitter, and per-model circuit breakers that prevent cascading cooldowns. 3. AES-256 Key Encryption: API keys are symmetrically encrypted with AES-256 and protected by current OS-user credentials (Windows DPAPI, macOS Keychain, or Linux Secret Service). Settings UI masks keys by default to prevent accidental leaks during streaming or screenshots. 4. Thread Safety & Background Persistence: All configuration state is thread-safe. Telemetry writes are handled by a throttled background single-writer thread, eliminating game stutters or TPS drops during auto-saves. 5. Reasoning Models & Adaptive Effort: Native support for modern reasoning models (Gemini 3.7/3.1 Thinking, OpenAI GPT-5/o-series, DeepSeek-R1/V4, Grok, Qwen, etc.). Normalizes thinking processes into standard Microsoft.Extensions.AI reasoning content, with automatic wire-format translation and adaptive parameter fallback. 6. Native Tool Calling (Function Calling): Fully compliant with Microsoft.Extensions.AI standards (AIFunction, ChatOptions.Tools, FunctionCallContent). Features RimWorldFunctionInvoker (.AsMainThreadFunctionInvokingClient()) to safely dispatch tool execution onto the Unity main thread, preventing cross-thread crashes. 7. Embedding SDK: First-class semantic search and vector embeddings powered by Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, or OpenAI-compatible endpoints, sharing daily budget and rate controls with chat. 8. Decision Models: Typed decision services for yes/no, choice, and probability scoring backed by TypeSafe System One (Jev), Google Gemini Decision and nine other providers, including local Ollama and Unsloth endpoints with zero configuration required. 9. Provider Analytics & Caching: Real-time request success metrics and server-side prompt cache hit tracking (reducing repetitive dialogue token costs by up to 80%). 10. Developer-First SDK: Exposes standard Microsoft.Extensions.AI abstractions (IChatClient, IEmbeddingGenerator) without bespoke wrappers or mandatory registration. Includes robust JSON repair and strict schema normalization. 11. Third-Party Mod Integration: Seamlessly redirect LLM traffic from RimTalk, Auto Translation, Mod Compatibility Checker, and Simplified Chinese Automation: One into RimLLM's resilient fallback, budget, and logging pipeline without modifying target mod keys. 12. Active Mod Insights: In-game settings tab detailing all active mods that declare dependencies on RimLLM or invoke its APIs during the current session.
